mapper.select: insert into lms_term (tenant_id, term_id, name, starts_on, ends_on, is_operating) values (current_setting('app.tenant'), '2026-2', '2026학년도 2학기', date '2026-09-01', date '2026-12-20', true) on conflict do nothing returning '{}'::text

insert into lms_course (tenant_id, course_code, name, credits, unit_code, category) values (current_setting('app.tenant'), 'DEMO1001', '데이터와 인공지능 기초', 3, 'CSE', 'major') on conflict do nothing returning '{}'::text

insert into lms_person (tenant_id, member_no, kind, unit_code, grade_year, source) select current_setting('app.tenant'), (20269000 + i)::text, 'student', (array['CSE','BIZ','EDU'])[1 + i % 3], 1 + i % 4, 'manual' from generate_series(1, 9) i on conflict (tenant_id, member_no) do nothing returning '{}'::text

insert into lms_section (tenant_id, term_id, course_code, section_no, title, mode, schedule, capacity, source) values (current_setting('app.tenant'), '2026-2', 'DEMO1001', '01', '데이터와 인공지능 기초 (01분반)', 'hyflex', '[{"day":"월","period":"1-2","room":"공학관 301"}]', 40, 'manual') on conflict (tenant_id, term_id, course_code, section_no) do nothing returning '{}'::text

with sec as (select section_id from lms_section where term_id = '2026-2' and course_code = 'DEMO1001' and section_no = '01'), w as (select g w, (timestamp '2026-09-07 09:00' + (g - 1) * interval '7 days') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' t from generate_series(1, 15) g) insert into lms_session (tenant_id, section_id, week_no, seq, kind, starts_at, ends_at, open_at, close_at, room) select current_setting('app.tenant'), sec.section_id, w.w, x.seq, 'class', w.t + (x.seq - 1) * interval '90 minutes', w.t + (x.seq - 1) * interval '90 minutes' + interval '75 minutes', w.t, w.t + interval '7 days', '공학관 301' from sec, w, (values (1), (2)) x(seq) where x.seq = 1 or w.w = 10 on conflict (tenant_id, section_id, week_no, seq) do nothing returning '{}'::text

with sec as (select section_id from lms_section where term_id = '2026-2' and course_code = 'DEMO1001' and section_no = '01') insert into lms_enrollment (tenant_id, section_id, person_id, kind, source) select current_setting('app.tenant'), sec.section_id, p.person_id, case when p.member_no = '20269009' then 'audit' else 'regular' end, 'manual' from sec, lms_person p where p.member_no between '20269001' and '20269009' on conflict do nothing returning '{}'::text

with sec as (select section_id from lms_section where term_id = '2026-2' and course_code = 'DEMO1001' and section_no = '01'), r as (insert into lms_attendance_rule (tenant_id, section_id, methods) select current_setting('app.tenant'), section_id, '{code,qr,nfc,ble,photo,online,manual}' from sec on conflict do nothing returning 1), b as (insert into lms_att_beacon (tenant_id, beacon_id, kind, room) values (current_setting('app.tenant'), 'NFC-ENG301', 'nfc', '공학관 301'), (current_setting('app.tenant'), 'BLE-ENG301', 'ble', '공학관 301') on conflict do nothing returning 1) select json_build_object('section_id', sec.section_id, 'sessions', (select count(*) from lms_session s where s.section_id = sec.section_id), 'students', (select count(*) from lms_enrollment e where e.section_id = sec.section_id and e.kind = 'regular'), 'rule', (select count(*) from r), 'beacons', (select count(*) from b))::text from sec

select coalesce(json_agg(x order by x.term_id desc, x.course_code, x.section_no), '[]')::text from ( select s.section_id, s.term_id, s.course_code, s.section_no, s.title, s.mode, (select count(*) from lms_enrollment e where e.section_id = s.section_id and e.status = 'enrolled' and e.kind = 'regular')::int students from lms_section s where s.status in ('open','closed')) x

select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('session_id', s.session_id, 'week_no', s.week_no, 'seq', s.seq, 'kind', s.kind, 'starts_at', lms_ts(s.starts_at), 'ends_at', lms_ts(s.ends_at), 'open_at', lms_ts(s.open_at), 'close_at', lms_ts(s.close_at), 'room', s.room, 'makeup_of', s.makeup_of, 'note', s.note, 'required_sec', s.required_sec, 'extra_study_sec', s.extra_study_sec) order by s.week_no, s.seq), '[]')::text from lms_session s where s.section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)

with u as (update lms_session set starts_at = coalesce(cast(#{starts_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz), starts_at), ends_at = coalesce(cast(#{ends_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz), ends_at), open_at = coalesce(cast(#{open_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz), open_at), close_at = coalesce(cast(#{close_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz), close_at), room = coalesce(#{room,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, room), kind = coalesce(#{kind,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, kind), note = coalesce(#{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, note), required_sec = coalesce(cast(#{required_sec,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), required_sec), extra_study_sec = coalesce(cast(#{extra_study_sec,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), extra_study_sec) where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid) returning *) select coalesce((select json_build_object('session_id', session_id, 'week_no', week_no, 'seq', seq, 'kind', kind, 'starts_at', lms_ts(starts_at), 'ends_at', lms_ts(ends_at), 'open_at', lms_ts(open_at), 'close_at', lms_ts(close_at), 'room', room, 'note', note, 'required_sec', required_sec, 'extra_study_sec', extra_study_sec)::text from u), '{"err":"not_found"}')

with o as (select * from lms_session where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), n as (insert into lms_session (tenant_id, section_id, week_no, seq, kind, starts_at, ends_at, open_at, close_at, room, makeup_of, note) select current_setting('app.tenant'), o.section_id, o.week_no, (select max(seq) + 1 from lms_session x where x.section_id = o.section_id and x.week_no = o.week_no), 'class', cast(#{starts_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz), cast(#{starts_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz) + coalesce(o.ends_at - o.starts_at, interval '75 minutes'), cast(#{starts_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz), cast(#{starts_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz) + interval '7 days', coalesce(#{room,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, o.room), o.session_id, '보강' from o returning *) select coalesce((select json_build_object('session_id', session_id, 'week_no', week_no, 'seq', seq, 'kind', kind, 'starts_at', lms_ts(starts_at), 'room', room, 'makeup_of', makeup_of)::text from n), '{"err":"not_found"}')

select case when not exists (select 1 from lms_section where section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)) then '{"err":"not_found"}' else ( select json_build_object('section_id', cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), 'methods', coalesce(to_json(r.methods), '["code","qr","nfc","ble","photo","online","manual"]'::json), 'late_after_min', coalesce(r.late_after_min, 10), 'absent_after_min', coalesce(r.absent_after_min, 30), 'online_min_pct', coalesce(r.online_min_pct, 90), 'require_identity', coalesce(r.require_identity, false), 'block_concurrent', coalesce(r.block_concurrent, true), 'hyflex_online', coalesce(r.hyflex_online, true))::text from (select 1) k left join lms_attendance_rule r on r.section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)) end

insert into lms_attendance_rule (tenant_id, section_id, methods, late_after_min, absent_after_min, online_min_pct, require_identity, block_concurrent, hyflex_online, updated_at) select current_setting('app.tenant'), s.section_id, coalesce((select array_agg(distinct m order by m) from jsonb_array_elements_text(cast(#{methods,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb)) m where m in ('code','qr','nfc','ble','photo','online','manual')), '{code,qr,nfc,ble,photo,online,manual}'), coalesce(cast(#{late_after_min,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), 10), coalesce(cast(#{absent_after_min,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), 30), coalesce(cast(#{online_min_pct,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), 90), coalesce(cast(#{require_identity,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as boolean), false), coalesce(cast(#{block_concurrent,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as boolean), true), coalesce(cast(#{hyflex_online,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as boolean), true), now() from lms_section s where s.section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid) on conflict (tenant_id, section_id) do update set methods = excluded.methods, late_after_min = excluded.late_after_min, absent_after_min = excluded.absent_after_min, online_min_pct = excluded.online_min_pct, require_identity = excluded.require_identity, block_concurrent = excluded.block_concurrent, hyflex_online = excluded.hyflex_online, updated_at = now() returning json_build_object('section_id', section_id, 'methods', to_json(methods), 'late_after_min', late_after_min, 'absent_after_min', absent_after_min, 'online_min_pct', online_min_pct, 'require_identity', require_identity, 'block_concurrent', block_concurrent, 'hyflex_online', hyflex_online)::text
select case when exists (select 1 from lms_section where section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)) then '{}' else '{"err":"not_found"}' end

with s as (select session_id, kind from lms_session where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), g as (select lpad(((('x' || substr(md5(gen_random_uuid()::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 1000000)::text, 6, '0') code, md5(gen_random_uuid()::text) || md5(gen_random_uuid()::text) sec), up as (insert into lms_attendance_code (tenant_id, session_id, code_hash, expires_at, qr_secret, rotate_sec, issued_at) select current_setting('app.tenant'), s.session_id, encode(sha256(convert_to(current_setting('app.tenant') || '|' || s.session_id::text || '|' || g.code, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), now() + make_interval(secs => cast(#{ttl_sec,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int)), g.sec, cast(#{rotate_sec,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), now() from s, g where s.kind <> 'holiday' on conflict (tenant_id, session_id) do update set code_hash = excluded.code_hash, expires_at = excluded.expires_at, qr_secret = excluded.qr_secret, rotate_sec = excluded.rotate_sec, issued_at = now() returning session_id, expires_at, qr_secret, rotate_sec) select case when not exists (select 1 from s) then '{"err":"not_found"}' when not exists (select 1 from up) then '{"err":"holiday"}' else ( select json_build_object('session_id', up.session_id, 'code', g.code, 'expires_at', lms_ts(up.expires_at), 'ttl_sec', cast(#{ttl_sec,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as int), 'rotate_sec', up.rotate_sec, 'qr', 'DDATT1.' || up.session_id || '.' || k.slot || '.' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(up.qr_secret || '|' || k.slot, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12))::text from up, g, lateral (select floor(extract(epoch from now()) / up.rotate_sec)::bigint slot) k) end

with s as (select ss.session_id, ss.section_id, ss.kind, ss.starts_at, ss.room, r.methods, coalesce(r.late_after_min, 10) late_min, coalesce(r.absent_after_min, 30) absent_min, coalesce(r.require_identity, false) need_idv from lms_session ss left join lms_attendance_rule r on r.section_id = ss.section_id where ss.session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), p as (select pe.person_id, e.kind ekind, e.status estatus from lms_person pe left join lms_enrollment e on e.person_id = pe.person_id and e.section_id = (select section_id from s) where pe.member_no = #{member_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), c as (select *, floor(extract(epoch from now()) / rotate_sec)::bigint slot from lms_attendance_code where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), b as (select * from lms_att_beacon where beacon_id = #{tag_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and active), v as (select s.*, p.person_id, c.expires_at, c.code_hash, c.slot, c.qr_secret, b.kind bkind, b.room broom, case when s.session_id is null then 'not_found' when s.kind = 'holiday' then 'holiday' when p.person_id is null or p.estatus is distinct from 'enrolled' then 'not_enrolled' when p.ekind = 'audit' then 'audit' when s.methods is not null and not (#{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = any(s.methods)) then 'method_off' when s.starts_at is null then 'no_time' when now() < s.starts_at - interval '10 minutes' then 'not_open' when now() > s.starts_at + make_interval(mins => s.absent_min) then 'closed' when exists (select 1 from lms_attendance a where a.session_id = s.session_id and a.person_id = p.person_id) then 'dup' when s.need_idv and #{idv,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null then 'idv_required' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in ('code', 'qr') and c.session_id is null then 'no_code' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in ('code', 'qr') and c.expires_at < now() then 'expired' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'code' and c.code_hash <> encode(sha256(convert_to(current_setting('app.tenant') || '|' || s.session_id::text || '|' || coalesce(#{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') then 'bad_code' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'qr' and coalesce(#{qr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') not in ('DDATT1.' || s.session_id || '.' || c.slot || '.' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(c.qr_secret || '|' || c.slot, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12), 'DDATT1.' || s.session_id || '.' || (c.slot - 1) || '.' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(c.qr_secret || '|' || (c.slot - 1), 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12)) then 'bad_qr' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in ('nfc', 'ble') and (b.beacon_id is null or b.kind <> #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) then 'bad_tag' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in ('nfc', 'ble') and b.room is distinct from s.room then 'room_mismatch' when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'photo' and (#{lat,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null or #{lng,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null) then 'need_geo' else 'ok' end r from (select 1) k left join s on true left join p on true left join c on true left join b on true), ins as (insert into lms_attendance (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, status, method, evidence) select current_setting('app.tenant'), v.session_id, v.person_id, case when now() > v.starts_at + make_interval(mins => v.late_min) then 'late' else 'present' end, #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('at', lms_ts(now()), 'ip', regexp_replace(coalesce(#{_ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '[0-9a-fA-F]+$', '*'), 'device', case when #{_ua,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null then 'unknown' when #{_ua,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ~* '(ipad|tablet)' then 'tablet' when #{_ua,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ~* '(mobi|android|iphone)' then 'mobile' else 'desktop' end, 'room', case when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in ('nfc','ble') then v.broom end, 'tag', case when #{method,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in ('nfc','ble') then #{tag_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} end, 'lat', round(cast(#{lat,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as numeric), 5), 'lng', round(cast(#{lng,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as numeric), 5), 'taken_at', lms_ts(cast(#{taken_at,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as timestamptz)), 'idv', case when #{idv,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is not null then 'sso_pending' end)) from v where v.r = 'ok' on conflict do nothing returning *) select case when (select r from v) <> 'ok' then json_build_object('err', (select r from v))::text when not exists (select 1 from ins) then '{"err":"dup"}' else ( select json_build_object('session_id', session_id, 'member_no', #{member_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'status', status, 'method', method, 'evidence', evidence)::text from ins) end

with s as (select session_id, section_id from lms_session where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), p as (select pe.person_id, e.kind, e.status from lms_person pe join lms_enrollment e on e.person_id = pe.person_id and e.section_id = (select section_id from s) where pe.member_no = #{member_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), old as (select a.status from lms_attendance a, p where a.session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid) and a.person_id = p.person_id), v as (select case when not exists (select 1 from s) then 'not_found' when not exists (select 1 from p where status = 'enrolled') then 'not_enrolled' when (select kind from p) = 'audit' then 'audit' when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'excused' and #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null then 'need_reason' else 'ok' end r), up as (insert into lms_attendance (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, status, method, evidence, reason, decided_at) select current_setting('app.tenant'), cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), p.person_id, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'manual', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('by', #{_actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ref', #{evidence_ref,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'at', lms_ts(now()))), #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() from p, v where v.r = 'ok' on conflict (tenant_id, session_id, person_id) do update set status = excluded.status, method = 'manual', evidence = lms_attendance.evidence || excluded.evidence, reason = coalesce(excluded.reason, lms_attendance.reason), decided_at = now() returning *), lg as (insert into lms_attendance_log (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, before, after, reason, actor) select current_setting('app.tenant'), up.session_id, up.person_id, (select status from old), up.status, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{_actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR} from up returning 1) select case when (select r from v) <> 'ok' then json_build_object('err', (select r from v))::text else (select json_build_object('session_id', up.session_id, 'member_no', #{member_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'status', up.status, 'method', up.method, 'reason', up.reason, 'before', (select status from old), 'logged', (select count(*) from lg))::text from up) end

with s as (select session_id, section_id from lms_session where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), t as (select pe.person_id, a.status from s join lms_enrollment e on e.section_id = s.section_id and e.status = 'enrolled' and e.kind = 'regular' join lms_person pe on pe.person_id = e.person_id left join lms_attendance a on a.session_id = s.session_id and a.person_id = pe.person_id where coalesce(a.status, 'absent') = #{from,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), up as (insert into lms_attendance (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, status, method, evidence, reason, decided_at) select current_setting('app.tenant'), cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), t.person_id, #{to,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'adjust', jsonb_build_object('by', #{_actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'at', lms_ts(now())), #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() from t on conflict (tenant_id, session_id, person_id) do update set status = excluded.status, method = 'adjust', reason = excluded.reason, evidence = lms_attendance.evidence || excluded.evidence, decided_at = now() returning person_id), lg as (insert into lms_attendance_log (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, before, after, reason, actor) select current_setting('app.tenant'), cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), t.person_id, t.status, #{to,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{_actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR} from t returning 1) select case when not exists (select 1 from s) then '{"err":"not_found"}' else json_build_object('session_id', cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), 'from', #{from,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'to', #{to,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'changed', (select count(*) from up), 'logged', (select count(*) from lg))::text end

with s as (select * from lms_session where session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), n as (select x.* from lms_session x, s where x.section_id = s.section_id and x.session_id <> s.session_id and x.kind <> 'holiday' and x.starts_at > s.starts_at and x.starts_at <= coalesce(s.ends_at, s.starts_at) + interval '3 hours' and (x.starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (s.starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date order by x.starts_at limit 1), up as (insert into lms_attendance (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, status, method, evidence, reason) select current_setting('app.tenant'), n.session_id, a.person_id, a.status, 'copy', jsonb_build_object('from', a.session_id, 'by', #{_actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), a.reason from n, lms_attendance a where a.session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid) on conflict do nothing returning 1) select case when not exists (select 1 from s) then '{"err":"not_found"}' when not exists (select 1 from n) then '{"err":"no_next"}' else json_build_object('source_session_id', cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), 'target_session_id', (select session_id from n), 'week_no', (select week_no from n), 'seq', (select seq from n), 'copied', (select count(*) from up))::text end

with sec as (select s.section_id, s.mode, coalesce(r.online_min_pct, 90) minp, coalesce(r.hyflex_online, true) hy from lms_section s left join lms_attendance_rule r on r.section_id = s.section_id where s.section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), ss as (select x.* from lms_session x, sec where x.section_id = sec.section_id and x.kind <> 'holiday' and (x.kind = 'online' or (sec.mode in ('hyflex','blended') and sec.hy and x.kind in ('class','live'))) and exists (select 1 from lms_content ct where ct.session_id = x.session_id)), st as (select e.person_id from lms_enrollment e, sec where e.section_id = sec.section_id and e.status = 'enrolled' and e.kind = 'regular'), calc as (select ss.session_id, ss.open_at, ss.close_at, st.person_id, round(100.0 * sum(least(coalesce(pg.watched_sec, 0), ct.duration_sec)) / greatest(sum(ct.duration_sec), 1))::int pct, bool_and(pg.completed_at is not null) all_done, max(pg.completed_at) done_at, sum(least(coalesce(pg.watched_sec, 0), ct.duration_sec))::int sec from ss cross join st join lms_content ct on ct.session_id = ss.session_id left join lms_progress pg on pg.content_id = ct.content_id and pg.person_id = st.person_id group by ss.session_id, ss.open_at, ss.close_at, st.person_id), dec as (select calc.*, case when pct >= (select minp from sec) and all_done and (open_at is null or done_at >= open_at) and (close_at is null or done_at <= close_at) then 'present' when close_at is not null and close_at < now() then 'absent' end st from calc), up as (insert into lms_attendance (tenant_id, session_id, person_id, status, method, evidence, online_sec) select current_setting('app.tenant'), session_id, person_id, st, 'online', jsonb_build_object('pct', pct, 'done_at', lms_ts(done_at)), sec from dec where st is not null on conflict (tenant_id, session_id, person_id) do update set status = excluded.status, evidence = excluded.evidence, online_sec = excluded.online_sec, decided_at = now() where lms_attendance.method = 'online' returning status) select case when not exists (select 1 from sec) then '{"err":"not_found"}' else json_build_object('section_id', cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid), 'sessions', (select count(*) from ss), 'present', (select count(*) from up where status = 'present'), 'absent', (select count(*) from up where status = 'absent'), 'kept_offline', (select count(*) from dec where st is not null) - (select count(*) from up))::text end

with sec as (select * from lms_section where section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), ss as (select s.* from lms_session s join sec on s.section_id = sec.section_id), st as (select pe.person_id, pe.member_no, pe.unit_code, pe.grade_year from lms_enrollment e join sec on e.section_id = sec.section_id join lms_person pe on pe.person_id = e.person_id where e.status = 'enrolled' and e.kind = 'regular'), cl as (select st.person_id, ss.session_id, ss.week_no, ss.seq, ss.kind, ss.starts_at, a.status, a.method, a.reason from st cross join ss left join lms_attendance a on a.session_id = ss.session_id and a.person_id = st.person_id) select case when not exists (select 1 from sec) then '{"err":"not_found"}' else json_build_object( 'section', (select json_build_object('section_id', section_id, 'term_id', term_id, 'course_code', course_code, 'section_no', section_no, 'title', title, 'mode', mode) from sec), 'sessions', coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('session_id', session_id, 'week_no', week_no, 'seq', seq, 'kind', kind, 'starts_at', lms_ts(starts_at), 'room', room, 'makeup_of', makeup_of) order by week_no, seq) from ss), '[]'), 'students', coalesce((select json_agg(x order by x.member_no) from (select st.member_no, st.unit_code, st.grade_year, (select json_agg(c.status order by c.week_no, c.seq) from cl c where c.person_id = st.person_id) cells, (select json_agg(c.method order by c.week_no, c.seq) from cl c where c.person_id = st.person_id) methods, (select json_build_object('present', count(*) filter (where status = 'present'), 'late', count(*) filter (where status = 'late'), 'absent', count(*) filter (where status = 'absent'), 'excused', count(*) filter (where status = 'excused'), 'unrecorded', count(*) filter (where status is null and kind <> 'holiday' and starts_at <= now()), 'past', count(*) filter (where kind <> 'holiday' and starts_at <= now())) from cl c where c.person_id = st.person_id) sum from st) x), '[]'), 'audit_excluded', (select count(*) from lms_enrollment e join sec on e.section_id = sec.section_id where e.kind = 'audit' and e.status = 'enrolled'))::text end

with sec as (select * from lms_section where section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), ss as (select s.* from lms_session s join sec on s.section_id = sec.section_id), st as (select pe.person_id, pe.member_no, pe.unit_code from lms_enrollment e join sec on e.section_id = sec.section_id join lms_person pe on pe.person_id = e.person_id where e.status = 'enrolled' and e.kind = 'regular'), cl as (select st.person_id, ss.week_no, ss.seq, ss.kind, ss.starts_at, a.status from st cross join ss left join lms_attendance a on a.session_id = ss.session_id and a.person_id = st.person_id), agg as (select person_id, count(*) filter (where status = 'present') p, count(*) filter (where status = 'late') l, count(*) filter (where status = 'absent' or (status is null and kind <> 'holiday' and starts_at <= now())) ab, count(*) filter (where status = 'excused') e, count(*) filter (where kind <> 'holiday' and starts_at <= now()) past from cl group by person_id) select case when not exists (select 1 from sec) then '{"err":"not_found"}' else json_build_object( 'filename', (select '출석부_' || course_code || '-' || section_no || '_' || term_id from sec), 'title', (select title || ' 출석부 (' || term_id || ')' from sec), 'legend', '○ 출석 · △ 지각 · × 결석 · ◎ 공결 · 휴 휴강 · 지각 3회 = 결석 1회', 'columns', (select json_agg(c) from (select '학번' c, 0 o, 0 o2 union all select '학과', 0, 1 union all select week_no || '주' || seq || '차', week_no, seq + 1 from ss union all select x, 99, n from unnest(array['출석','지각','결석','공결','결석환산','출석률(%)']) with ordinality u(x, n) order by o, o2) cc), 'rows', coalesce((select json_agg(r order by m) from (select st.member_no m, (select json_agg(v) from (select st.member_no v, 0 o, 0 o2 union all select coalesce(st.unit_code, ''), 0, 1 union all select case c.status when 'present' then '○' when 'late' then '△' when 'absent' then '×' when 'excused' then '◎' else case when c.kind = 'holiday' then '휴' else '' end end, c.week_no, c.seq + 1 from cl c where c.person_id = st.person_id union all select x, 99, n from agg, unnest(array[agg.p::text, agg.l::text, agg.ab::text, agg.e::text, (agg.ab + agg.l / 3)::text, (case when agg.past = 0 then 100 else round(100.0 * (agg.p + agg.l + agg.e) / agg.past) end)::int::text]) with ordinality u(x, n) where agg.person_id = st.person_id order by o, o2) vv) r from st) rr), '[]'))::text end
select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('beacon_id', beacon_id, 'kind', kind, 'room', room, 'active', active) order by beacon_id), '[]')::text from lms_att_beacon

insert into lms_att_beacon (tenant_id, beacon_id, kind, room, active) values (current_setting('app.tenant'), #{beacon_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{kind,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{room,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cast(#{active,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as boolean)) on conflict (tenant_id, beacon_id) do update set kind = excluded.kind, room = excluded.room, active = excluded.active returning json_build_object('beacon_id', beacon_id, 'kind', kind, 'room', room, 'active', active)::text

with sec as (select section_id from lms_section where section_id = cast(#{section_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)), ct as (select c.content_id, c.title, c.duration_sec, coalesce(c.check_at_sec, c.duration_sec) chk, s.week_no from lms_content c join lms_session s on s.session_id = c.session_id join sec on s.section_id = sec.section_id), ev as (select e.person_id, ct.content_id, ct.title, ct.week_no, case when e.kind = 'rate' and e.rate_x100 > 100 and coalesce(e.pos, 0) < ct.chk then 'speed_before_check' when e.kind = 'seek' and e.pos - e.from_pos > 10 and e.from_pos < ct.chk then 'skip' when e.kind = 'blocked' then 'concurrent' end k, e.at from lms_play_event e join ct on ct.content_id = e.content_id where e.kind in ('rate','seek','blocked')), ov as (select a.person_id, ct.content_id, ct.title, ct.week_no, 'concurrent' k, b.started_at at from lms_play a join lms_play b on b.person_id = a.person_id and b.play_id <> a.play_id and b.started_at > a.started_at and b.started_at < coalesce(a.ended_at, a.last_beat_at) join ct on ct.content_id = b.content_id), al as (select * from ev where k is not null union all select * from ov) select case when not exists (select 1 from sec) then '{"err":"not_found"}' else coalesce((select json_agg(x order by x.last_at desc, x.member_no, x.kind) from ( select p.member_no, p.unit_code, al.title content_title, al.week_no, al.k kind, count(*)::int n, lms_ts(max(al.at)) last_at from al join lms_person p on p.person_id = al.person_id group by p.member_no, p.unit_code, al.title, al.week_no, al.k limit 500) x), '[]')::text end

with me as (select person_id from lms_person where member_no = #{member_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), en as (select e.section_id, e.kind from lms_enrollment e, me where e.person_id = me.person_id and e.status = 'enrolled') select json_build_object('member_no', #{member_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'found', exists (select 1 from me), 'sections', coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('section_id', s.section_id, 'title', s.title, 'term_id', s.term_id, 'mode', s.mode, 'kind', en.kind, 'rule', (select json_build_object('methods', coalesce(to_json(r.methods), '["code","qr","nfc","ble","photo","online","manual"]'::json), 'require_identity', coalesce(r.require_identity, false), 'late_after_min', coalesce(r.late_after_min, 10), 'absent_after_min', coalesce(r.absent_after_min, 30)) from (select 1) k left join lms_attendance_rule r on r.section_id = s.section_id), 'sessions', (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('session_id', ss.session_id, 'week_no', ss.week_no, 'seq', ss.seq, 'kind', ss.kind, 'starts_at', lms_ts(ss.starts_at), 'room', ss.room, 'status', a.status, 'method', a.method, 'reason', a.reason, 'open', ss.kind <> 'holiday' and ss.starts_at is not null and now() between ss.starts_at - interval '10 minutes' and ss.starts_at + make_interval(mins => coalesce(r2.absent_after_min, 30))) order by ss.week_no, ss.seq), '[]') from lms_session ss left join lms_attendance a on a.session_id = ss.session_id and a.person_id = (select person_id from me) left join lms_attendance_rule r2 on r2.section_id = ss.section_id where ss.section_id = s.section_id), 'sum', (select json_build_object('present', count(*) filter (where a.status = 'present'), 'late', count(*) filter (where a.status = 'late'), 'absent', count(*) filter (where a.status = 'absent'), 'excused', count(*) filter (where a.status = 'excused'), 'past', count(*) filter (where ss.kind <> 'holiday' and ss.starts_at <= now())) from lms_session ss left join lms_attendance a on a.session_id = ss.session_id and a.person_id = (select person_id from me) where ss.section_id = s.section_id)) order by s.term_id desc, s.course_code, s.section_no) from en join lms_section s on s.section_id = en.section_id), '[]'))::text

select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('member_no', p.member_no, 'before', l.before, 'after', l.after, 'reason', l.reason, 'actor', l.actor, 'at', lms_ts(l.at)) order by l.at desc, p.member_no), '[]')::text from lms_attendance_log l join lms_person p on p.person_id = l.person_id where l.session_id = cast(#{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as uuid)
